mekayis.metin: (نَأَلَ) النُّونُ وَالْهَمْزَةُ وَاللَّامُ، لَيْسَ فِيهِ إِلَّا النَّأَلَانُ: الْمَشْيُ السَّرِيعُ. يَنْهَضُ الْمَاشِي بِرَأْسِهِ إِلَى فَوْقٍ. وَرَجُلٌ نَؤُولٌ، وَضَبُعٌ نَؤُولٌ، إِذَا فَعَلْتَ ذَلِكَ.

vikisozluk.baslik:
نؤل (form I)
# نَؤُلُّ (naʔullu) /na.ʔul.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of أَلَّ (ʔalla)
# نُؤَلُّ (nuʔallu) /nu.ʔal.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of أَلَّ (ʔalla)
# نَؤُلَّ (naʔulla) /na.ʔul.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of أَلَّ (ʔalla)
# نُؤَلَّ (nuʔalla) /nu.ʔal.la/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive/juss

نَؤُلْ • (naʔul) (form I) /na.ʔul/
# first-person plural non-past active jussive of آلَ (ʔāla)

نأل (form I)
# نَأَلُّ (naʔallu) /na.ʔal.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of أَلَّ (ʔalla)
# نَأَلَّ (naʔalla) /na.ʔal.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of أَلَّ (ʔalla)
# نَأَلِّ (naʔalli) /na.ʔal.li/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of أَلَّ (ʔalla)

نؤول (form I)
# نَؤُولُ (naʔūlu) /na.ʔuː.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of آلَ (ʔāla)
# نَؤُولَ (naʔūla) /na.ʔuː.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of آلَ (ʔāla)
نَائِل • (nāʔil) (feminine نَائِلَة (nāʔila), masculine plural نَائِلُون (nāʔilūn), feminine plural نَائِلَات (nāʔilāt))

vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
Derived from the active participle of نَالَ (nāla).
